tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every panel (the workbench). Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel and button face. Text on it: ink, ink-muted, accent-ink, danger, review.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Sunken wells: resource chips, disabled buttons, future act segments. Text on it: ink, ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and pixel glyphs on bg, panel and sunk (≥10:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: button sub-lines, costs, captions, on bg / panel / sunk (≥4.8:1).

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The 4px pixel frame around panels and buttons (≥4.7:1 on panel and bg).

tokens.name: bevel-hi
tokens.usage: Top-left inner highlight of a raised pixel button.

tokens.name: bevel-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom-right inner shade of a raised pixel button; also the drop step under frames.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lamp-green fill: the major verb, done act segments, affordable. Text on it: on-accent only.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent and lamp fills (≥10:1).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Green as text: gains (+0.18/s), 'done' labels, on panel and bg (≥5:1).

tokens.name: lamp
tokens.usage: Desk-lamp gold: micro-events (微事件), the live act segment marker, world lights. Text on it: on-accent.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rust text and outlines for irreversible verbs (停止印刷) and noise, on panel and bg (≥4.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-fill
tokens.usage: Face of a danger button. Text on it: on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on danger-fill (≥8:1).

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Director / review surface only: outlines and text on panel and review-fill (≥5:1). Never on the player surface.

tokens.name: review-fill
tokens.usage: Director panel face. Text on it: ink or review.

tokens.name: term
tokens.usage: Workshop log terminal background (both themes stay dark).

tokens.name: term-ink
tokens.usage: Phosphor text of the newest log line on term (≥12:1).

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: Older log lines on term (≥6.6:1).

tokens.name: world-sky
tokens.usage: Stage sky band behind the pixel scene.

tokens.name: world-ground
tokens.usage: Stage ground band.

tokens.name: world-block
tokens.usage: Scene silhouettes: desk, buildings, machines.

tokens.name: world-block-2
tokens.usage: Second silhouette depth: far buildings, shelf backs.

tokens.name: world-light
tokens.usage: Lit windows, paper sheets, stars in the scene.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Act numerals and the ending title's Latin part. Silkscreen at 6× its 8px grid.

styles.name: display-num
styles.usage: Resource values and rates. Latin digits only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Act title on the stage. 3× the 12px grid.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Every button label. 2× — never 18px or 20px: off-grid sizes blur the glyphs.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Button sub-lines, costs, captions, log lines. 1×.

styles.name: meta
styles.sample: 已自动保存 · 当前浏览器
styles.usage: Status line, save status, chip labels.

tokens.name: px
tokens.usage: One chrome pixel. Matches one glyph pixel at the 24px label size.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Frame thickness step; icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; gap between stacked buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding; gap in the action dock.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; page gutter at 390px.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Stage insets; between page sections at 1280px.

tokens.name: touch
tokens.usage: Minimum button height (above the 44px floor, on the 4px grid).

radius.note: The system has no rounded corners. Corners are notched by the frame shadows instead (one chrome pixel cut from each corner).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every panel, button, chip and segment.

shadow.note: Pixel frames are box-shadows, not borders: four 4px offsets leave each corner notched, like NES-era UI. Pressed = bevel inverted, element shifts down 4px.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Notched 4px outline on panels and buttons.

tokens.name: frame-drop
tokens.usage: Frame plus a one-step hard drop: raised panels and enabled buttons.

tokens.name: bevel
tokens.usage: Raised face of an enabled button (combine after frame-drop).

tokens.name: bevel-press
tokens.usage: :active face; the drop disappears and the button moves down 4px.

meta.note: Pixel refactor of the v3 paper-and-ink system. Hues carried over (ink, paper, green, rust, blue, gold); values re-cut for a 2-theme pixel palette.
